prompt: Which player has the third-highest goals-per-match ratio among the top 15 all-time goalscorers in UEFA European Championship history?
answer:
**Patrick Kluivert** has the third-highest goals-per-match ratio among the top 15 all-time UEFA European Championship scorers: **6 goals in 9 matches (0.67 goals per match)**.

He ranks behind Michel Platini (**1.80**) and Alan Shearer (**0.78**).
